name: LocalAGI
description: Self-hosted agent platform for creating assistants, automations and chat bots that run entirely on local models.
whatItDoes: Users create agents in a web UI with a few clicks, without writing code or needing cloud keys. Agents can be connected to channels such as Telegram and extended with skills.
howItWorks: Docker Compose starts the platform together with a local model backend, with separate compose files for CPU, NVIDIA, Intel and AMD GPUs. Agents are managed at localhost:8080 and can connect to MCP servers.

requirements.name: GPU
requirements.description: Optional acceleration; CPU-only setup is the default
